instruction: Use GIMP to open the .xcf file located on the Desktop, copy the image, insert it into a new LibreOffice Impress presentation, and save the presentation as 'presentation.pptx' to the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);
